@file:w5/missions-context.js.每個模型都有自己的 context window。中途換模型，新模型要把整段對話: Every model has its own context window. If you switch models in the middle of a chat, the new model has to read the whole conversation from the beginning, and it can't use the cache either. That turn uses a lot more of your usage at once, and the reply is slower. This mission practices two things: pick the model before you start; and if you really have to switch, first ask the original model to write a hand-off summary, then start a new chat and switch there.
